about: Journey under the stars, behold the future beyond.
Two young adults return to their lost hometown in search of truth and to bring back what they hold dear.
Story: The town of Hallfein was once situated at the border of three provinces, and thrived due to mining and trade.
However, a mysterious disaster struck the town, causing most of its residents to disappear and leading to it becoming a restricted area.
As time passed, restrictions on the town were lifted, and a plan to restore it was initiated.
Seizing this opportunity, a young woman and a young man, having come of age after being driven from Hallfein long ago, now return to the land they once called home.
summary: Journey under the stars, behold the future beyond.
